description: Read one program intake request's details: the program's intake definition read against the answers the request holds. Every field comes back in the definition's order and groups with its state (answered, suggested, open, does not apply), the answer, who gave it and whether it can be edited. `applicable: false` means the record is not an intake request.

initiativeId.description: An initiative a program intake agent created. Pass this or workItemId.

workItemId.description: A program intake draft or completed request. Pass this or initiativeId.

name: anyforge_get_intake_request_details
title: Get intake request details
